JobBoardUpdate.description:
Partial update: only the fields sent change. Only `feed`, `rss_url_template` and
`email_alert` can be null.

The import method is set whole: `feed`, `rss_url_template` and `email_alert` are sent
only with `import_method`, and the ones not sent are cleared. To import from a feed
send `api` and the feed, from an RSS `rss` and its template, from email alerts `email`
and the alert, and to stop send `none`.

post.description:
Add every offer of a job alert email to the inbox, as pending, with the job board
that imports the alert (import method `email`) as their source; the ones that fit no
search profile are filtered. Any LinkedIn job alert is read, whatever its search.

Duplicates are skipped. Each offer links to the posting without the email's tracking.
Offers of alerts never expire and there is no limit: an alert lists only new offers.

409.description: No job board imports this email alert (`email-alert-not-imported`); nothing changed

post.description:
Add every offer of the job board's feed or RSS to the inbox, as pending, with the
job board as their source; the ones that fit no search profile are filtered. Himalayas
and the RSS are searched by the titles of every profile; RSS items read
`Company: Title`.

Duplicates are skipped; pending imported offers of this job board that left its feed
or RSS are discarded as expired. A job board can be imported at most once every 6
hours (each source's terms).

409.description: The job board's import method is `none` (`job-board-not-imported`) or `email` (`job-board-imported-by-email`)

429.description: Imported less than 6 hours ago (`feed-cooldown`); `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait

502.description: The feed or RSS did not answer or could not be read (`feed-unavailable`); nothing changed

get.description:
Conversion from each stage to the next one, over every application.

An application reached a stage when its stage is that one or a later one; closed
applications count up to the stage they reached, and open ones count too.
The same conversion, for each channel with applications.

Applications in progress per stage: no outcome and not accepted.

Unlike the `active` filter of the application list (no outcome), it leaves out
accepted applications, whose process is over.
Offers from the most recently added.

post.description:
Have the offer reader read up to 5 pending imported offers: their work mode, whether
they can be done living in the location of the search profiles they fit, and whether
they are stable jobs. What a reading says filters the offer like the profile's words.

An offer is read once for each location of the profiles it fits by its words; offers
without a description are never read. Call it again while `left` is not 0; an offer
the reader fails on is left to be read.
